=== FrFlowGen/Shelf/Domain/Term_good.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Shelf.Types

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Shelf

/-- Books -/
@[frflow_defs] def good (minPages : Int) : Book → Prop :=
  fun (b : Book) => (b.pages ≥ minPages)

frflow_match_eqns

end Shelf

=== FrFlowGen/Shelf/Domain/Term_shown.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Shelf.Types

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Shelf

/-- Picking -/
@[frflow_defs] def shown (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) : (List Book) → Book → Prop :=
  fun (l : (List Book)) (b : Book) => (b ∈ (picks l ((l).length : Int)))

frflow_match_eqns

end Shelf

import FrFlowGen.Shelf.EveryLong.Spec

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Shelf.EveryLong.Auto
open Shelf.EveryLong

set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false in
theorem complete : Obl.complete := by
  unfold Obl.complete
  first
    | (intro minPages picks h_Pick
       simp only [Shelf.EveryLong.claim, Shelf.Pick.claim, Shelf.Pick.post, List.forall_mem_map, forall_and] at h_Pick ⊢
       revert h_Pick
       try simp only [and_imp]
       repeat' (first | (with_reducible assumption) | (with_reducible intro _) | (with_reducible apply And.intro))
       done)
    | frflow_auto

end Shelf.EveryLong.Auto

=== FrFlowGen/Shelf/EveryLong/Spec.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Shelf.Types
import FrFlowGen.Shelf.Pick.Spec

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Shelf.EveryLong

@[frflow_defs] def claim (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) : Prop :=
  (∀ (l : (List Book)) (n : Int), (∀ b ∈ l, ((b.pages ≥ minPages) → (b ∈ (picks l n)))))

namespace Obl

/-- The parts of EveryLong (Pick) together make it. -/
@[frflow_defs] def complete : Prop :=
  ∀ (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), ∀ (h_Pick : (Shelf.Pick.claim minPages picks)), (Shelf.EveryLong.claim minPages picks)

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- EveryLong holds whatever Pick says. -/
@[frflow_defs] def vacuous : Prop :=
  ∀ (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), (Shelf.EveryLong.claim minPages picks)

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- Pick follows from EveryLong. -/
@[frflow_defs] def restates : Prop :=
  ∀ (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), ∀ (h_EveryLong : (Shelf.EveryLong.claim minPages picks)), (Shelf.Pick.claim minPages picks)

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- The parts of EveryLong contradict each other. -/
@[frflow_defs] def clash : Prop :=
  ∀ (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), ∀ (h_Pick : (Shelf.Pick.claim minPages picks)), False

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- No world meets EveryLong. -/
@[frflow_defs] def unsat : Prop :=
  ∀ (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), ¬ (Shelf.EveryLong.claim minPages picks)

end Obl

frflow_match_eqns

end Shelf.EveryLong

=== FrFlowGen/Shelf/EveryLong/Theorems.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Shelf.EveryLong.Auto

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Shelf.EveryLong

/-- EveryLong holds of every world that meets the leaves below it: Pick. -/
theorem holds : ∀ (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), ∀ (h_Pick : (Shelf.Pick.claim minPages picks)), (Shelf.EveryLong.claim minPages picks) := by
  intro minPages picks h_Pick
  exact Shelf.EveryLong.Auto.complete (minPages := minPages) (picks := picks) (h_Pick := h_Pick)

end Shelf.EveryLong

=== FrFlowGen/Shelf/FromList/Spec.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Shelf.Types
import FrFlowGen.Shelf.Pick.Spec

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Shelf.FromList

@[frflow_defs] def claim (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) : Prop :=
  (∀ (l : (List Book)) (n : Int), (∀ b ∈ (picks l n), (b ∈ l)))

namespace Obl

/-- The parts of FromList (Pick) together make it. -/
@[frflow_defs] def complete : Prop :=
  ∀ (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_Pick : (Shelf.Pick.claim minPages picks)), (Shelf.FromList.claim picks)

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- FromList holds whatever Pick says. -/
@[frflow_defs] def vacuous : Prop :=
  ∀ (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), (Shelf.FromList.claim picks)

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- Pick follows from FromList. -/
@[frflow_defs] def restates : Prop :=
  ∀ (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_FromList : (Shelf.FromList.claim picks)), (Shelf.Pick.claim minPages picks)

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- The parts of FromList contradict each other. -/
@[frflow_defs] def clash : Prop :=
  ∀ (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_Pick : (Shelf.Pick.claim minPages picks)), False

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- No world meets FromList. -/
@[frflow_defs] def unsat : Prop :=
  ∀ (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), ¬ (Shelf.FromList.claim picks)

end Obl

frflow_match_eqns

end Shelf.FromList

=== FrFlowGen/Shelf/OnlyGood/Spec.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Shelf.Types
import FrFlowGen.Shelf.Domain.Term_shown
import FrFlowGen.Shelf.Domain.Term_good
import FrFlowGen.Shelf.FromList.Spec
import FrFlowGen.Shelf.OnlyLong.Spec
import FrFlowGen.Shelf.EveryLong.Spec

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Shelf.OnlyGood

@[frflow_defs] def claim (Item : Type) (shown : ((List Item) → Item → Prop)) (good : (Item → Prop)) : Prop :=
  (∀ (l : (List Item)) (x : Item), ((shown l x) = ((x ∈ l) ∧ (good x))))

namespace Obl

/-- The parts of OnlyGood (FromList, OnlyLong, EveryLong) together make it. -/
@[frflow_defs] def complete : Prop :=
  ∀ (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_FromList : (Shelf.FromList.claim picks)) (h_OnlyLong : (Shelf.OnlyLong.claim picks minPages)) (h_EveryLong : (Shelf.EveryLong.claim minPages picks)), (Shelf.OnlyGood.claim Book (Shelf.shown picks) (Shelf.good minPages))

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- OnlyGood holds without FromList. -/
@[frflow_defs] def needed_FromList : Prop :=
  ∀ (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_OnlyLong : (Shelf.OnlyLong.claim picks minPages)) (h_EveryLong : (Shelf.EveryLong.claim minPages picks)), (Shelf.OnlyGood.claim Book (Shelf.shown picks) (Shelf.good minPages))

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- OnlyGood holds without OnlyLong. -/
@[frflow_defs] def needed_OnlyLong : Prop :=
  ∀ (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_FromList : (Shelf.FromList.claim picks)) (h_EveryLong : (Shelf.EveryLong.claim minPages picks)), (Shelf.OnlyGood.claim Book (Shelf.shown picks) (Shelf.good minPages))

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- OnlyGood holds without EveryLong. -/
@[frflow_defs] def needed_EveryLong : Prop :=
  ∀ (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_FromList : (Shelf.FromList.claim picks)) (h_OnlyLong : (Shelf.OnlyLong.claim picks minPages)), (Shelf.OnlyGood.claim Book (Shelf.shown picks) (Shelf.good minPages))

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- The parts of OnlyGood contradict each other. -/
@[frflow_defs] def clash : Prop :=
  ∀ (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_FromList : (Shelf.FromList.claim picks)) (h_OnlyLong : (Shelf.OnlyLong.claim picks minPages)) (h_EveryLong : (Shelf.EveryLong.claim minPages picks)), False

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- No world meets OnlyGood. -/
@[frflow_defs] def unsat : Prop :=
  ∀ (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ¬ (Shelf.OnlyGood.claim Book (Shelf.shown picks) (Shelf.good minPages))

end Obl

namespace Obl

/-- OnlyGood is met by doing nothing (picks: returning nothing). -/
@[frflow_defs] def idle : Prop :=
  ∀ (minPages : Int), (Shelf.OnlyGood.claim Book (Shelf.shown (fun (x0 : (List Book)) (x1 : Int) => [])) (Shelf.good minPages))

end Obl

frflow_match_eqns

end Shelf.OnlyGood

=== FrFlowGen/Shelf/OnlyGood/Theorems.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Shelf.OnlyGood.Auto
import FrFlowGen.Shelf.FromList.Theorems
import FrFlowGen.Shelf.OnlyLong.Theorems
import FrFlowGen.Shelf.EveryLong.Theorems

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Shelf.OnlyGood

/-- OnlyGood holds of every world that meets the leaves below it: Pick. -/
theorem holds : ∀ (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_Pick : (Shelf.Pick.claim minPages picks)), (Shelf.OnlyGood.claim Book (Shelf.shown picks) (Shelf.good minPages)) := by
  intro picks minPages h_Pick
  exact Shelf.OnlyGood.Auto.complete (picks := picks) (minPages := minPages) (h_FromList := (Shelf.FromList.holds (picks := picks) (minPages := minPages) (h_Pick := h_Pick))) (h_OnlyLong := (Shelf.OnlyLong.holds (picks := picks) (minPages := minPages) (h_Pick := h_Pick))) (h_EveryLong := (Shelf.EveryLong.holds (minPages := minPages) (picks := picks) (h_Pick := h_Pick)))

end Shelf.OnlyGood

=== FrFlowGen/Shelf/Pick/Eval.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Shelf.Pick.Spec

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Shelf.Pick.Eval

/-- example 1 (only the long book) -/
theorem eval_0 : (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300), (Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] 5 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] := by
  frflow_eval

theorem eval_0_opposite : ¬ (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300), (Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] 5 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] := by
  frflow_eval

/-- example 2 (no book is long enough: none is picked) -/
theorem eval_1 : (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] 5 [] := by
  frflow_eval

theorem eval_1_opposite : ¬ (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] 5 [] := by
  frflow_eval

/-- example 3 (a short book is never picked) -/
theorem eval_2 : ¬ (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300), (Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] 5 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] := by
  frflow_eval

theorem eval_2_opposite : (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300), (Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] 5 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] := by
  frflow_eval

/-- example 4 (a long book is not left on the shelf) -/
theorem eval_3 : ¬ (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] 5 [] := by
  frflow_eval

theorem eval_3_opposite : (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] 5 [] := by
  frflow_eval

/-- probe 1 -/
theorem probe_0 : ¬ (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300), (Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20), (Shelf.Book.mk "LongLong" 300)] 300 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] := by
  frflow_eval

theorem probe_0_opposite : (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300), (Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20), (Shelf.Book.mk "LongLong" 300)] 300 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] := by
  frflow_eval

/-- probe 2 -/
theorem probe_1 : ¬ (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20), (Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] 5 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] := by
  frflow_eval

theorem probe_1_opposite : (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20), (Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] 5 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] := by
  frflow_eval

/-- probe 3 -/
theorem probe_2 : ¬ (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300), (Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20), (Shelf.Book.mk "" 300)] 20 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] := by
  frflow_eval

theorem probe_2_opposite : (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300), (Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20), (Shelf.Book.mk "" 300)] 20 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] := by
  frflow_eval

/-- probe 4 -/
theorem probe_3 : ¬ (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300), (Shelf.Book.mk "LongLong" 300)] 4 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] := by
  frflow_eval

theorem probe_3_opposite : (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300), (Shelf.Book.mk "LongLong" 300)] 4 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] := by
  frflow_eval

/-- probe 5 -/
theorem probe_4 : (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300), (Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] 300 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] := by
  frflow_eval

theorem probe_4_opposite : ¬ (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300), (Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] 300 [(Shelf.Book.mk "Long" 300)] := by
  frflow_eval

/-- probe 6 -/
theorem probe_5 : (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20), (Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] (-5) [] := by
  frflow_eval

theorem probe_5_opposite : ¬ (Shelf.Pick.post 100) [(Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20), (Shelf.Book.mk "Short" 20)] (-5) [] := by
  frflow_eval

end Shelf.Pick.Eval

=== FrFlowGen/Shelf/Pick/Spec.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Shelf.Types

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Shelf.Pick

@[frflow_defs] def post (minPages : Int) : (List Book) → Int → (List Book) → Prop :=
  fun (shelf : (List Book)) (n : Int) (picked : (List Book)) => ((∀ b ∈ picked, ((b ∈ shelf) ∧ (b.pages ≥ minPages))) ∧ (∀ b_1 ∈ shelf, ((b_1.pages ≥ minPages) → (b_1 ∈ picked))))

@[frflow_defs] def claim (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x0 : (List Book)) (x1 : Int), (Shelf.Pick.post minPages) x0 x1 (picks x0 x1)

namespace Obl

/-- No world meets Pick. -/
@[frflow_defs] def unsat : Prop :=
  ∀ (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), ¬ (Shelf.Pick.claim minPages picks)

end Obl

frflow_match_eqns

end Shelf.Pick

=== FrFlowGen/Shelf/Pick/Theorems.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Shelf.Pick.Spec

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Shelf.Pick

/-- Pick holds of every world that meets the leaves below it: Pick. -/
theorem holds : ∀ (minPages : Int) (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)), ∀ (h_Pick : (Shelf.Pick.claim minPages picks)), (Shelf.Pick.claim minPages picks) := by
  intro minPages picks h_Pick
  exact h_Pick

end Shelf.Pick

=== FrFlowGen/Shelf/RootImpl.lean ===
-- GENERATED by FrFlow from the Scala model. Do not edit.

import FrFlowGen.Shelf.OnlyGood.Theorems

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace Shelf.RootImpl

/-- The root holds of the code, from what is trusted: Pick. -/
theorem root_impl : ∀ (picks : (List Book) → Int → (List Book)) (minPages : Int), ∀ (h_Pick : (Shelf.Pick.claim minPages picks)), (Shelf.OnlyGood.claim Book (Shelf.shown picks) (Shelf.good minPages)) :=
  by
  intro picks minPages h_Pick
  exact Shelf.OnlyGood.holds (picks := picks) (minPages := minPages) (h_Pick := h_Pick)

#print axioms Shelf.RootImpl.root_impl

end Shelf.RootImpl
